The inability to act freely is a flower's fate.

to you. Even if you kill me, this
Shield won't open.

I'm a homunculus. Manufactured life. My mind was

#C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF had a mind. Of her own volition

That homunculus has a mind.
…any living thing, no matter how difficult

this way. If #C236196003Rani #RUBSEighth#RUBEVIII#REND#CDEF thinks logical behavior

program thing.

Humans are plenty wasteful. But that doesn't
benefit humans. I will give them a
proper education.

This is the Labyrinth that utilizes my mind.
Thus, I desire for people to enter and develop
personalities without waste.

A proper education, she says.
But this is a regulation born out of an
extreme preference, right?

What a laudable thing for a mere puppet to say.

Will you truly be a "proper judge"?

That's why I'm training #[him][her]#. Everything is for

Huh…!?
Damn. I went with the flow when
I shouldn't have.

I'd have it easy if someone made me a tight
schedule, but an overbearing production
assistant is essentially a controller.

I can't keep unconditional deadlines! It's a
bad example, but I'll answer with at least
that much mettle!

…so it wasn't helpful, huh? However, you must
have done some self-reflection. That alone
should've been good for you, I think.

…self-reflection. It's a nice word. For some
reason, my chest feels cool. I want to make you
reflect even more now.

Why are you following such a one-sided order?
#C236196003#NICK#CDEF, you're being over-disciplined!
You're doing what the devs want you to!

Th-that's right.
There's absolutely no reason to self-reflect.

A lifestyle where even a single mistake isn't
permitted, where you ignore people in trouble
and only prioritize your goals―it's too constrained!

It's a way of being an even more outstanding
human. There's no reason you would deny that.
I mean, didn't it feel good?
It felt pretty nice.
It didn't make me feel good at all!

I need to carefully refute her one more time.
Putting the pros and cons of strict schedules
aside, there's something wrong with what #C236196003Rani#CDEF
is saying somewhere.

…that can't be. My program is perfect.
Everything has been for the sake of making you
into an even more outstanding human.

Fighting behavior won't occur here.
All I'm doing is outstanding management.
So then why? Why deny that?

I made it this far.
There's nothing left to worry about.

#C236196003Rani#CDEF's contradiction.
The desire that she's hiding.
It's―――

Yeah. All of these conditions have been nothing
but the "ideals of how things ought to be"
that #C236196003Rani#CDEF desires.
These three are #C236196003Rani#CDEF's ideals.

4. You may take ambiguous actions.
5. You may fail now and then.
6. You may make a mistake or two.
These three are #C236196003Rani#CDEF's #RUBS compromises#RUBErealities#REND.

7. Herbivores are preferable to carnivores.
8. You must prefer warm colors over cold.
9. Girls with glasses are supreme.
These three are #C236196003Rani#CDEF's desires.

What existed in this Labyrinth is the "voice of
her mind" which she can never put into words.
That is to say―――

You did it, Praetor! Yes. The garden of a girl's
mind, which holds the seeds of her secrets――
I never tire of seeing it!

A mind which desires the ideal lover―――No,
maybe it's a desire to remold one into the ideal
lover. A modest secret, but definitely an #C000246204SG#CDEF!

Alright! The grand opening of the Secret Garden!
Darling, go, go!

Good timing.
Take your harvest, mongrel.

Ah… This is what it's like to have your
mind peered into… My temperature is rising…
I might… disappear…

While hiding her face with both hands,
#C236196003Rani#CDEF breaks apart like glasswork.

I regret having to expose her secret, but with
this, I've nullified the Shield. All that's left
is to proceed on, but…

This floor's #C236196003Rani#CDEF has disappeared, and it would
be fine to break that "no fighting here" rule,
but…

I'll see how things play out a little longer.
I can't use my full strength if my audience
is so low level, anyway.

…you seem like you'll become my kind of bunny
with a little refining… Okay.
I'll give you a chance.

I'll pull back this time. I, who loves to bully
weaklings, am returning on purpose, see?

Go ahead and be moved to tears by my generosity
and beauty. If you want, you can wave a
glow stick back and forth too.
…I can't believe it, but we're saved.

Maybe she's upholding her contract with #C236196003Rani#CDEF,
but it seems that #C236196003Lancer#CDEF won't fight us
on this floor.

Could it be that she's also being made to
fight against her will by #C236196003BB#CDEF…?

Against my will? That's not it at all.
You see, I'm the one who sold myself to #C236196003BB#CDEF.

I chose the #C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF
because I liked it. Uhh, my original Master…
the #ROFS0001#RUBS  Magus #RUBE#C000246204Wizard#CDEF#REND who summoned and contracted me?

Our hobbies didn't really match. That's why I
stabbed her from behind and killed her. You
could say we had "creative differences."
Knave―――What did you just say?
You scum… You betrayed your original Master?

…I can't overlook what you just said.
Could you tell me in more detail?

I don't care if you were on bad terms with your
Master, but… you say you sold yourself to #C236196003BB#CDEF?
You, an anti-Heroic Spirit―a Servant?

Oh? Would you like to know?
Hm… Stars DO always have documentaries.
Fine, I'll talk about it.

Look, I had no choice but to do it.
That's why I made it a stab from behind.
I said this, loudly:
"This woman isn't suited to be my #ROFS-003#RUBS   manager#RUBEemployer#REND."

"But #C236196003BB#CDEF, what you say sounds lovely.
Those words, 'you can live forever,' are sweet
like mock strawberries."

And thus our contract was established.
She flat out refused to transfer me onto
an idol, but hey, what can you do?

Any longer and I would've disappeared.
Losing this beauty of mine would be a loss to
the entire world, don't you think?
…for such a reason, she betrayed her Master?

A Master who was brought to the #C000246204Far Side of
the Moon#CDEF and chose "not to obey" #C236196003BB#CDEF?

Such a reason?
Such a reason, you say?
This reason was more important than anything!

As long as I and only I am more beautiful
than anyone else, everything will be fine!

…I don't even need to check to tell
how furious #C236196003#SVT#CDEF is.

#C236196003Lancer#CDEF, who thinks it's natural to sneak
attack her own Master, is fundamentally
different from other Servants.

Never before was there a Servant this
infatuated with their "own desire."

I will live forever.
Beautiful, charming, and above all!

To me, the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF and you Masters are
nothing more than background scenery.
Like lemons to be squeezed.

As a manager, she's super excellent, see?
She should be giving me a most wonderful
body very soon.

Until then, keep quivering in your sleep.
This world will soon become MY very own stage!

…I would very much like to stop her, but we would
have no chance of winning if we fought now.
#C236196003#SVT#CDEF must have also sensed that since #SVT[she][he][she][he]# kept #SVT[her][his][her][his]# 
mouth shut and endured it.

I would very much like to stop her, but we would
have no chance of winning if we fought now.
…in any case, a path to a new floor opened up.

#C236196003Gatou#CDEF has collapsed.
Actually, he's clamoring about.

I feel like my worries have dissipated,
to a certain extent. I'm not very surprised
to see this.

Illustration of the Tigers' Feast
of Sacrificed Fleeesh!
That's how I feel. Good to see you, #[lad][lass]#.

I, as you can see, am in quite a pinch. I hunger
and am tired; lack sleep and have a revelatory
fever; I was starting to see Calvary Hill.

My pain is like that of Prometheus, who brought
civilization to humanity. Figuratively, also
like Odin, near death on the Ash Tree.

Ditch the metaphors, man.
…anyway, #C236196003Gatou#CDEF, you old man. Why'd you waltz
into something dangerous like the Labyrinth?
